title: ローイングエルゴメーター
description: 体育施設やジムの内装向けのローイング器具。長いシートレールと固定したローラー台、ファン形の外装・開いた格子、角度付き足台と固定ストラップ、保管位置の引き棒・コード、無表示モニターを造形。ファン内部の駆動、座面移動、引き動作や負荷・運動計測は含みません。安全・身体適合性や実機性能は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.770 × 1.132 × 2.275 m、21,472三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A rowing-machine prop for sports-center and gym interiors, with long seat rail and fixed roller carriage, fan-shaped housing and open grille, angled foot cradles with fixed straps, parked pull handle/cord and inactive monitor. Internal fan drive, seat travel, rowing motion, resistance and exercise measurement are absent. Safety, body fit and equipment performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.770 × 1.132 × 2.275 m; 21,472 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
